arxiv-2007-00656.title: Throughput Analysis for Virtual MIMO WSNs over Measured MIMO Channels
arxiv-2007-00656.creator: I. Dey, M. Majid Butt, N. Marchetti
arxiv-2007-00656.description: Abstract A recently conducted indoor-to-outdoor measurement campaign for investigating the propagation characteristics of an 8 × 8 8\times 8 virtual multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) based wireless sensor network (WSN) is presented in this paper. The campaign is conducted in an instrumentation room devoid of windows, but filled with different noisy electrical and measuring units.

arxiv-2110-00886.title: Spindle: Techniques for Optimizing Atomic Multicast on RDMA Conference: ; 2021
arxiv-2110-00886.creator: Sagar Jha 1 , Lorenzo Rosa 1,2 and Ken Birman 1 1 Cornell University, 2 University of Bologna
arxiv-2110-00886.description: Abstract . Leveraging one-sided RDMA for applications that replicate small data objects can be surprisingly difficult: such uses amplify any protocol overheads. Spindle is a set of optimization techniques for systematically tackling this class of challenges for atomic multicast over RDMA. These include memory polling optimizations using novel sender and receiver batching techniques, null-message send logic, and improved multi-thread synchronization.

arxiv-2111-12541.title: Rethinking the modeling of the instrumental response of telescopes with a differentiable optical model
arxiv-2111-12541.creator: Tobias Liaudat, Jean-Luc Starck, Martin Kilbinger, Pierre-Antoine Frugier
arxiv-2111-12541.description: Abstract We propose a paradigm shift in the data-driven modeling of the instrumental response field of telescopes. By adding a differentiable optical forward model into the modeling framework, we change the data-driven modeling space from the pixels to the wavefront.

arxiv-2212-05585.title: Gravity from the Determinant of the Energy-Momentum: Astrophysical Implications
arxiv-2212-05585.creator: Hemza Azri 1, Salah Nasri 1,2
arxiv-2212-05585.description: Abstract Determinants of the second-rank tensors stand useful in forming generally invariant terms as in the case of the volume element of the gravitational actions. Here, we extend the action of the matter fields by an arbitrary function f ⁡ ( 𝑫 ) f(\bm{D}) of the determinants of their energy-momentum, and the metric, 𝑫 = | det .

arxiv-2303-02301.title: Locally universal C ∗ \mathrm{C}^{*} -algebras with computable presentations Thanks: Goldbring was partially supported by NSF grant DMS-2054477. Hart was funded by the NSERC.
arxiv-2303-02301.creator: Alec Fox, Isaac Goldbring, and Bradd Hart
arxiv-2303-02301.description: Abstract . The Kirchberg Embedding Problem (KEP) asks if every C ∗ \mathrm{C}^{*} -algebra embeds into an ultrapower of the Cuntz algebra 𝒪 2 \mathcal{O}_{2} . In an effort to provide a negative solution to the KEP and motivated by the recent refutation of the Connes Embedding Problem, we establish two computability-theoretic consequences of a positive solution to KEP.

arxiv-2306-13610.title: Quotients, pure existential completions and Arithmetic Universes
arxiv-2306-13610.creator: Maria Emilia Maietti, Davide Trotta
arxiv-2306-13610.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Maria Emilia Maietti, Davide Trotta. We provide a new description of Joyal’s arithmetic universes through a characterization of the exact and regular completions of pure existential completions. We show that the regular and exact completions of the pure existential completion of an elementary doctrine P P are equivalent to the 𝗋𝖾𝗀 / 𝗅𝖾𝗑 \mathsf{reg}/\mathsf{lex} and 𝖾𝗑 / 𝗅𝖾𝗑 \mathsf{ex}/\mathsf{lex} -completions, respectively, of the category of predicates of P P . This result generalizes a previous one by the first author with F.

arxiv-2403-13982.title: Virasoro constraints and representations for quiver moduli spaces
arxiv-2403-13982.creator: Woonam Lim, Miguel Moreira
arxiv-2403-13982.description: Abstract . We study the Virasoro constraints for moduli spaces of representations of quiver with relations by Joyce’s vertex algebras. Using the framed Virasoro constraints, we construct a representation of half of the Virasoro algebra on the cohomology of moduli stacks of quiver representations under smoothness assumption.

arxiv-2502-14864.title: Benchmarking Multimodal RAG through a Chart-based Document Question-Answering Generation Framework
arxiv-2502-14864.creator: Yuming Yang, Jiang Zhong, Li Jin, Jingwang Huang, Jingpeng Gao, Qing Liu, Yang Bai, Jingyuan Zhang, Rui Jiang, Kaiwen Wei
arxiv-2502-14864.description: Abstract Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MRAG) enhances reasoning capabilities by integrating external knowledge. However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on simple image-text interactions, overlooking complex visual formats like charts that are prevalent in real-world applications. In this work, we introduce a novel task, Chart-based MRAG , to address this limitation.

arxiv-2510-10331.title: LLM-Friendly Knowledge Representation for Customer Support
arxiv-2510-10331.creator: Hanchen Su, Wei Luo, Wei Han, Yu Liu, Yufeng Zhang, Cen Zhao, Joy Zhang, Yashar Mehdad
arxiv-2510-10331.description: Abstract We propose a practical approach by integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) with a framework designed to navigate the complexities of Airbnb customer support operations. In this paper, our methodology employs a novel reformatting technique, the Intent, Context, and Action (ICA) format, which transforms policies and workflows into a structure more comprehensible to LLMs.

arxiv-2602-02547.title: naPINN: Noise-Adaptive Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Recovering Physics from Corrupted Measurement
arxiv-2602-02547.creator: Hankyeol Kim, Pilsung Kang
arxiv-2602-02547.description: Abstract Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) are effective methods for solving inverse problems and discovering governing equations from observational data. However, their performance degrades significantly under complex measurement noise and gross outliers. To address this issue, we propose the Noise-Adaptive Physics-Informed Neural Network ( naPINN ), which robustly recovers physical solutions from corrupted measurements without prior knowledge of the noise distribution.

pmc-10630618.title: Structural and functional connectome relationships in early childhood
pmc-10630618.creator: Yoonmi Hong, Emil Cornea, Jessica B Girault, Maria Bagonis, Mark Foster, Sun Hyung Kim, Juan Carlos Prieto, Haitao Chen, Wei Gao, Martin A Styner, John H Gilmore
pmc-10630618.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). There is strong evidence that the functional connectome is highly related to the white matter connectome in older children and adults, though little is known about structure-function relationships in early childhood. We investigated the development of cortical structure-function coupling in children longitudinally scanned at 1, 2, 4, and 6 years of age (N = 360) and in a comparison sample of adults (N = 89).

pmc-10666073.title: A Case Report of an Unusual Presentation of a Pedunculated Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumor: Acute Upper Gastrointestinal Bleeding in a 57-Year-Old Female
pmc-10666073.creator: Atheer Almutairi, Alanoud Almuhana, Rahaf Alanazi, Ali AlZughbi, Abduljaleel Al Alwan
pmc-10666073.description: Gastrointestinal stromal tumors (GISTs) are rare tumors accounting for 0.1-3% of gastrointestinal (GI) neoplasms. ‏In the past, GIST was classified as leiomyomas, leiomyosarcomas, and leiomyoblastomas. However, now it is evident that GIST is a separate tumor entity, and it is the most frequent sarcoma of the GI tract.

pmc-11448702.title: Comparing different motion correction approaches for resting-state functional connectivity analysis with functional near-infrared spectroscopy data
pmc-11448702.creator: Costanza Iester, Laura Bonzano, Monica Biggio, Simone Cutini, Marco Bove, Sabrina Brigadoi
pmc-11448702.description: .SignificanceMotion artifacts are a notorious challenge in the functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) field. However, little is known about how to deal with them in resting-state data.AimWe assessed the impact of motion artifact correction approaches on assessing functional connectivity, using semi-simulated datasets with different percentages and types of motion artifact contamination.ApproachThirty-five healthy adults underwent a 15-min resting-state acquisition.

pmc-11651504.title: Unveiling the mystery: Investigating the debate surrounding mitochondrial DNA copy number and Sjögren syndrome using Mendelian randomization analysis
pmc-11651504.creator: Jie Zhou, Yixin Xu, Haitao Wang, Chao Chen, Kun Wang
pmc-11651504.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Numerous studies have investigated the relationship between mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) copy number and Sjögren syndrome (SS). However, the conclusions remain inconclusive, with conflicting findings. The genome-wide association study summary statistics for mtDNA copy number were obtained from 2 sources: a cohort of 465,809 White individuals from the Cohorts for Heart and Aging Research in Genomic Epidemiology consortium and the UK Biobank, and a dataset of 395,718 UK Biobank participants.

pmc-13017630.title: Temperature-dependent regulation of diapause and hatching success in aphids: implications for climate change
pmc-13017630.creator: Roma Durak, Martyna Materowska, Sławomir Bartoszewski, Magdalena Misiorek, Colin Brent
pmc-13017630.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Diapause is a crucial adaptive strategy that enables insects, including aphids, to survive unfavorable environmental conditions, particularly during winter. Diapause of aphids takes the form of facultative and embryonic diapause occurring in the eggs. This study investigates the diapause dynamics of aphids, based on Maculolachnus submacula (Walker), at 3 different temperatures to assess the impact of elevated temperatures on embryonic development and hatching success. To determine the diapause strategy and to detect dividing cells, immunostaining was performed.

pmc-13379455.title: Probing the influence of PsbS on thylakoid lipid fluidity
pmc-13379455.creator: Shiun-Jr Yang, Henry E Lam, Katherine H Richardson, Matthew P Johnson, Gabriela S Schlau-Cohen
pmc-13379455.description: Due to fluctuations in sunlight intensity, balancing light-harvesting efficiency and photoprotection is critical for plant fitness. To achieve this balance, plants have evolved a highly regulated mechanism, non-photochemical quenching (NPQ), which is activated under excess light to dissipate absorbed energy and deactivated under low light to preserve photosynthetic efficiency.

pmc-13384859.title: Datopotamab deruxtecan in solid tumors: Recent research progress and clinical applications
pmc-13384859.creator: Ying Cao, Li-qin Mo, Ya-juan Liu, Zhen Zhang
pmc-13384859.description: Following the approval of the first antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) for solid tumors, the therapeutic landscape in cancer has been revolutionized. Datopotamab deruxtecan (Dato-DXd) is a TROP2-targeting ADC which is composed of a humanized monoclonal antibody and a potent topoisomerase I inhibitor via a tetrapeptide-based cleavable linker.

pmc-13612107.title: 18 F-FDG and 68 Ga-FAPI PET/CT Imaging in a Patient with High-Grade Meningioma: A Case Report
pmc-13612107.creator: Arif Satria Putra Pratama, Hendra Budiawan, Trias Nugrahadi, Achmad Hussein Sundawa Kartamihardja
pmc-13612107.description: High-grade meningiomas exhibit aggressive biological behavior and may benefit from functional imaging for further characterization. We report a 50-year-old female presenting with a 1-year history of intermittent right-sided headache and recurrent seizures. Contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging demonstrated a well-defined extra-axial mass arising from the right sphenoid wing dura mater, accompanied by hyperostosis, dural tail sign, and vasogenic edema.

pmc-13655418.creator: Jae-Myun Ko, Wi-Young So, Jae-Hyun Jung
pmc-13655418.description: [Purpose] The time of day at which exercise is performed influences physiological responses and performance, and thus its health benefits.
